parameters.text: ={{ 'Execute approved operational task: ' + $json.objective + '. Constraints: ' + JSON.stringify($json.constraints) + '. Allowed tools: ' + JSON.stringify($json.allowedTools) }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={

  "results": $('Enforce Security & Initialize State').first().json.results,
  "failures": $('Enforce Security & Initialize State').first().json.failures,
